entries.def:
ἐν-νεύω 
[in LXX: Pro.6.13; 10.10 (קָרַץ), Sir.27.22 A * ;] 
to nod to, make a sign to: with dative of person(s), Luk.1.62.†
(AS)

ἔννοια, -ας, ἡ
(νοῦς), [in LXX: Pro.1.4; 2.11; 3.21; 4.1; 5.2; 8.12; 16.22; 18.15; 19.7; 23.4, 19; 24.7 (מְזִמָּה, etc.), Wis.2.14, Da TH Sus.1.28* ;] 
__1. thinking, consideration. 
__2. a thought, purpose, design: Heb.4.12, 1Pe.4.1.†
SYN.: ἐνθῦμησις, which see (Cremer, 439) (AS)

ἔν-νομος, -ον 
[in LXX: Sir, Pro.1.1-33 ogue 12* ;] 
__1. lawful, legal (MM, Exp., xiii): Act.19.39. 
__2. Of persons, 
__(a) law-abiding; 
__(b) under law: ἔ. Χριστοῦ, in relation to Christ, 1Co.9.21 (Cremer. 435).†
(AS)

ἔννυχος, -ον
(νύξ), [in LXX: 3Ma.5.5 * ;] (in cl. poët.; prose in late Gk. only) 
nightly. Neut., adverbially, ἔννυχα (Rec. -χον), by night: Mrk.1.35.†
(AS)

ἐν-οικέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly (29/36) for יָשַׁב ;] 
to dwell in; metaphorically, before ἐν, with dative of person(s): ὁ θεός, 2Co.6.16 τ. πνεῦμα, Rom.8.11, 2Ti.1.14; ὁ λόγος, Col.3.16 πίστις, 2Ti.1.5 ἁμαρτία, Rom.7.17.†
(AS)

ἐν-οχλέω, -ῶ
(ὄχλος), [in LXX for חָלָה ;] 
to trouble: with accusative, Heb.12.15. Pass., before ἀπό, Luk.6.18.†
(AS)

ἔνοχος, -ον (= ἐνεχόμενος), 
(in LXX for רָשַׁע hi., etc. ;] 
__1. held in, bound by: with genitive (cl. with dative), δουλείας, Heb.2.15. 
__2. In law-phrases 
__(a) liable to a charge or action (cl. with dative, of crime): with dative, of the tribunal (MM, Exp., xiii), Mat.5.21-22; before εἰς (Field, Notes, 4 f.), Mat.5.22 
__(b) with genitive, of the punishment (Gen.26.11): θανάτου, Mat.26.66, Mrk.14.64; …

ἔνταλμα, -τος, τό
(ἐντέλλω), [in LXX: Job.23.11 (אָשֻׁר) Job.23.12, Isa.29.13 (מִצְוָה), Isa.55.11 (aliter in Heb.)* ;] 
a precept: pl., Mat.15.9 (LXX), Mrk.7.7, Col.2.22.†
(AS)

ἐνταφιάζω 
[in LXX: Gen.50.2 (חָנַט; cf. ἐνταφιαστής, Gen.50.2 for רָפָא; see Deiss., BS, 120 f.; MM, Exp., xiii)* ;] 
a κοινή word (Deiss., LAE, 723), 
to prepare for burial: Mat.26.12, Jhn.19.40.†
(AS)
